# Wyrlight

> Wyrlight is a minimalist digital design brand creating Nordic-inspired vector graphics, illustration and print-on-demand artwork.

Wyrlight focuses on clean visual design, SVG-based workflows and carefully crafted apparel graphics. All artwork is created in-house and published through the Wyrlight ecosystem.

## Main Website

* [Home](https://wyrlight.com): Main brand homepage and introduction.
* [Vector Art](https://wyrlight.com/vector.html): Minimalist vector graphics and logo-style artwork.
* [Graphic Art](https://wyrlight.com/graphic.html): Graphic illustrations and apparel-oriented artwork.
* [Info](https://wyrlight.com/info.html): Brand background and design philosophy.

## Content

* Minimalist vector artwork
* Graphic illustration
* Nordic-inspired visual design
* SVG workflow and digital asset creation
* Print-on-demand apparel graphics

## External Presence

* [Portfolio](https://sites.google.com/view/wyrlight-portfolio/home/): Extended visual portfolio.
* [GitHub](https://github.com/Wyrlight/Wyrlight): Public project repository and documentation.
